asr.full_text: Hello friends, today we will make special roasted semolina halwa You will like its taste, texture and color 100% I will share all the tips with you To make this tasty and roasted semolina halwa, I will show you all the ingredients I have taken all the ingredients out I have measured all the ingredients from the 1.5 cup I have used 1.5 cup wheat, 1.5 cup semolina and 1 cup of rice flour I have used 1 1 in 1 cup of ghee, 1 1 in 1 cup of sugar and 1 in 1 cup of semolina I have used 1 flour to make roti I have used a little cardamom powder As well as some kesar threads And some dried fruits Add saffron Now we will add dry fruits In this recipe, you can use any Semolina First of all we have to roast the Semolina We will roast it without any oil Keep the flame on low Roast for 4-5 minutes or until raw flavour comes out The small pieces of Semolina flaky and becomes a Sheera Sauté well It makes the granules of suji Blow up And will form a great form Sauté it continuously I am making it golden brown It's been 3-4 minutes Its started looking like golden brown Soji is now well sauted I want the color of sooji halwa little brownish To which I am giving this a little dark brown We have to make it on low flame So if you do not want to darken. It means your halwa does not want the brown color So you may stop it after 3-4 minutes So I will make it a little brown Let it keep frying I will show you how much time it should continue Switch off the flame after 3-4 mins I'll cook till it gets little brown Suji have turned little brown Turn the flame off Make sure it is not too dark brown Other colours will be added along with the dough Transfer it on a plate Next I have here a pan In which we'll make syrup Here I am using 1.5 cup water I want 3 times of suji water For 1.5 cup suji I m using 1.5 cup water Suji takes a lot of water And it makes halwa very juicy Add sugar That which was at the side That makes sugar sweet If you like it sweet You can add 3-4 cup sugar Mix it Till sugar melts Leave it to boil Look, water has boiled Wait for it to boil Sugar have boiled Now add Cardamom powder And saffron thread Now add saffron thread If you want you will do it You can also add saffron colour And if you like a little brownish colour I will add it If you want, then add orange or saffron in this You can cut your halwa in saffron colour But I will make a brown halwa So I am not using any colour You can give some turmeric too For yellow color See it has boiled well Don't over cook it Turn off the flame After the sugar melts, keep it aside If sheera is ready then halwa will be very fast Turn off the flame Sugar is melted well If sheera will be ready then its ready Transfer the suji in the pan Add 1 tablespoon ghee Once ghee melts Add dry fruit Fry cashew nuts & almonds It needs more longer to fry Lets fry it for 1-2 mins When it becomes light golden brown Finally we will add kishmish It doesn't take long to cook It will puff up soon and we will take out all dry fruits Frying dry fruits will add flavour to halwa You can use raw if you want Add some onion as well Then'll take them out Frying dry fruits makes this Halwa a very tasty one If you want you can use Raw Halwa But frying them will enhance the flavor All the fruits has been in there In the same pan add 1 tablespoon Ghee I am not adding the whole ghee together This is very important Most important secret trick Add 1tbsp Of Dough Now fry it very well By that the color of Halwa will be changed The color of the dough will give the Hal is a little brownish And it gives you nice texture We will keep on roasting with the help of a wooden spoon This is little quantity It will takes 2 min only to roast Look the mix starts to turn golden brown Then it will not darken You can wait for 1 minute till it reaches the right darkness Since it has become brownish Then we can put the rest of the ghee Then take 1-2 tbsp of ghee It's turned brownish We will now add other mixture No need to add the entire ghee add the fried sesame seeds See how sweet it look Roast for 3-4 mins By the way we have roasted all the vegetables It won't use much time Saute it for 5 minutes We have sauteed sooji nicely Now its time not to saute Just saute it till it is mixed with ghee Ghee will be on side See friends its darker fry for few minutes it got dark after frying it looks like a fat and it has also become loose i fried in low flame now we'll add sugar syrup into this it is little boiling will add in this Add sugar syrup Don't worry about it boiling Mix and cook on high flame Sugar syrup will be soaked in suji Sugar syrup is prepared separately I have soaked all sugar syrup I have made sugar syrup separately If you want to make it directly, you can make it in a pot you can add 1.5 cup of water and sugar Your sugar syrup will easily prepare Suji is soaking See, how much seeds are separated Turn the gas flame on low Cover it cover the flame for 4-5 mins Soji gets done and cherimop will also absorb the syrup So if you try this halwa, then you can share their pictures with me on my social You can also check my english channel also I will give their Link is in description box Let's check the lid Like said earlier, the colour is brown Water is soaked in Suji Cook it well Will fry for one more minute Now I'll in dry fruits The water shouldn't be too dry because if you use soji, it gets dry Mix it for one minute Now mix them well The gas flame is off You can see the perfect texture At last, add 1 tsp ghee Mix it well Add 1 tsp of Ghee Ghee has come up This is a natural mixture Put it in the vessel It is cooked well Remove from the pan You can add more fruits Also add pistachios Enjoy this Let me taste Please try this suji halwa Hope you like it So all these will be Bhog Try this Suji Halwa If you enjoyed watching my video Press like Subscribe my channel Let me show you its texture I have added its texture now In this plate Let me show you its texture Each granol is perfectly moist and juicy Try this recipe And I meet you later

segments.text: Hello friends, today we will make special roasted semolina halwa
You will like its taste, texture and color 100%
I will share all the tips with you
To make this tasty and roasted semolina halwa, I will show you all the ingredients
I have taken all the ingredients out
I have measured all the ingredients from the 1.5 cup
I have used 1.5 cup wheat, 1.5 cup semolina and 1 cup of rice flour
I have used 1 1 in 1 cup of ghee, 1 1 in 1 cup of sugar and 1 in 1 cup of semolina
I have used 1 flour to make roti
I have used a little cardamom powder
As well as some kesar threads And some dried fruits Add saffron Now we will add dry fruits In this recipe, you can use any Semolina First of all we have to roast the Semolina
We will roast it without any oil
Keep the flame on low
Roast for 4-5 minutes or until raw flavour comes out
The small pieces of Semolina flaky and becomes a Sheera Sauté well It makes the granules of suji
Blow up
And will form a great form
Sauté it continuously
I am making it golden brown
It's been 3-4 minutes
Its started looking like golden brown
Soji is now well sauted I want the color of sooji halwa little brownish
To which I am giving this a little dark brown
We have to make it on low flame
So if you do not want to darken.
It means your halwa does not want the brown color
So you may stop it after 3-4 minutes
So I will make it a little brown
Let it keep frying I will show you how much time it should continue Switch off the flame after 3-4 mins I'll cook till it gets little brown
Suji have turned little brown
Turn the flame off
Make sure it is not too dark brown
Other colours will be added along with the dough
Transfer it on a plate
Next I have here a pan
In which we'll make syrup
Here I am using 1.5 cup water
I want 3 times of suji water
For 1.5 cup suji
I m using 1.5 cup water
Suji takes a lot of water
And it makes halwa very juicy
Add sugar
That which was at the side
That makes sugar sweet
If you like it sweet
You can add 3-4 cup sugar
Mix it
Till sugar melts
Leave it to boil
Look, water has boiled Wait for it to boil Sugar have boiled
Now add Cardamom powder
And saffron thread
Now add saffron thread
If you want you will do it
You can also add saffron colour
And if you like a little brownish colour I will add it If you want, then add orange or saffron in this You can cut your halwa in saffron colour
But I will make a brown halwa
So I am not using any colour
You can give some turmeric too
For yellow color
See it has boiled well
Don't over cook it
Turn off the flame
After the sugar melts, keep it aside If sheera is ready then halwa will be very fast Turn off the flame Sugar is melted well
If sheera will be ready then its ready
Transfer the suji in the pan Add 1 tablespoon ghee
Once ghee melts
Add dry fruit
Fry cashew nuts & almonds
It needs more longer to fry
Lets fry it for 1-2 mins
When it becomes light golden brown
Finally we will add kishmish
It doesn't take long to cook
It will puff up soon
and we will take out all dry fruits
Frying dry fruits will add flavour to halwa You can use raw if you want Add some onion as well Then'll take them out
Frying dry fruits makes this Halwa a very tasty one If you want you can use Raw Halwa
But frying them will enhance the flavor
All the fruits has been in there
In the same pan add 1 tablespoon Ghee
I am not adding the whole ghee together
This is very important Most important secret trick Add 1tbsp Of Dough
Now fry it very well
By that the color of Halwa will be changed
The color of the dough will give the Hal is a little brownish And it gives you nice texture
We will keep on roasting with the help of a wooden spoon
This is little quantity
It will takes 2 min only to roast
Look the mix starts to turn golden brown
Then it will not darken
You can wait for 1 minute
till it reaches the right darkness
Since it has become brownish
Then we can put the rest of the ghee Then take 1-2 tbsp of ghee It's turned brownish We will now add other mixture
No need to add the entire ghee
add the fried sesame seeds
See how sweet it look
Roast for 3-4 mins
By the way we have roasted all the vegetables It won't use much time Saute it for 5 minutes
We have sauteed sooji nicely Now its time not to saute
Just saute it till it is mixed with ghee
Ghee will be on side
See friends its darker fry for few minutes it got dark
after frying it looks like a fat and it has also become loose
i fried in low flame
now we'll add sugar syrup
into this it is little boiling will add in this Add sugar syrup
Don't worry about it boiling
Mix and cook on high flame
Sugar syrup will be soaked in suji Sugar syrup is prepared separately I have soaked all sugar syrup
I have made sugar syrup separately
If you want to make it directly, you can make it in a pot you can add 1.5 cup of water and sugar
Your sugar syrup will easily prepare
Suji is soaking
See, how much seeds are separated
Turn the gas flame on low Cover it cover the flame for 4-5 mins
Soji gets done and cherimop will also absorb the syrup
So if you try this halwa, then you can share their pictures with me on my social
You can also check my english channel also
I will give their Link is in description box
Let's check the lid
Like said earlier, the colour is brown
Water is soaked in Suji
Cook it well
Will fry for one more minute
Now I'll in dry fruits
The water shouldn't be too dry
because if you use soji, it gets dry
Mix it for one minute Now mix them well
The gas flame is off
You can see the perfect texture
At last, add 1 tsp ghee
Mix it well Add 1 tsp of Ghee Ghee has come up
This is a natural mixture
Put it in the vessel It is cooked well Remove from the pan
You can add more fruits
Also add pistachios
Enjoy this
Let me taste
Please try this suji halwa Hope you like it So all these will be Bhog
Try this Suji Halwa If you enjoyed watching my video
Press like
Subscribe my channel
Let me show you its texture
I have added its texture now
In this plate

Each granol is perfectly moist and juicy
Try this recipe
And I meet you later
